title: The simulation of judgment in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model-generated reliability ratings of news outlets against expert benchmarks (NewsGuard and MBFC) to identify systematic misclassification asymmetries across different political orientations (Left, Center, Right), and analyzing the political alignment of generated explanatory keywords.

Comparing LLM reliability assessments with non-expert human judgments using a structured agentic workflow to observe the replication of 'skepticism bias' (the tendency to disproportionately reject accurate information or reliable sources).
